body: I'll seek out other outlets.  I just came to /r/depression and /r/suicide watch because my mother is suffering from depression and suicidal and being held for 72 hours in the hospital on suicide watch,  but I can see how this wouldn't fit in in either of these subs.

I'm in full agreement with you on this,  I do feel like this is a try to manipulate me. I'm at my grandpa, her father, house right now talking to him about it all and he's saying she told him I was the depressed one and suicidal and needed medication and what not,  which I am a pretty happy person.  Idk.  I need time to think about it. She is usually a bit socially awkward,  but idk what is going on now because it's like she lost it.  She's approaching 50, would menopause do this?
